objective: Implement deck-list image recognition import for Yu-Gi-Oh NEURON / Master Duel images so recognized cards are added to search rows in bulk.

evidence.ui: Session panel exposes a compact '뉴런/마듀 덱 이미지 등록' file input and displays reading, recognition, success, warning, and error states.
evidence.api: POST /api/deck-image-recognition exists for Vercel and local Express; image validation and missing provider configuration are handled.
evidence.providerBoundary: OpenAI vision logic lives under src/adapters/deck-recognition/openaiVision.ts, outside UI components.
evidence.domainBoundary: Recognition types, response normalization, deduplication, and row append/merge logic live under src/domain/deck-image-recognition/.
evidence.browserFlow: Playwright mock upload added recognized rows and displayed unresolved warnings.
evidence.configGuard: GET /api/deck-image-recognition exposes provider availability without leaking secrets, and the UI disables deck upload when OPENAI_API_KEY is missing.
evidence.developmentDeployment: https://carddamda-develop.vercel.app points to https://carddamda-fkocc7xjb-hanc0ms-projects.vercel.app; remote build passed and includes api/deck-image-recognition.
evidence.providerConfiguration: OPENAI_API_KEY is configured locally in .env.local and in Vercel Preview as an encrypted environment variable.
evidence.localConfigEndpoint: GET http://localhost:5174/api/deck-image-recognition returns available:true with provider openai and model gpt-5.2.
evidence.liveRecognitionSmoke: A temporary synthetic deck-list PNG produced HTTP 200 from the local API and recognized six Yu-Gi-Oh cards with correct quantities and no unresolved rows.

knownLimitations: Vercel Deployment Protection returns 401 to unauthenticated curl against the dev alias, so remote runtime availability was verified by environment inspection and redeploy rather than public endpoint curl.
Real NEURON/Master Duel screenshot recognition still needs a user-provided screenshot sample for product-quality calibration.
The feature relies on model vision rather than a local Yu-Gi-Oh visual identity database, so uncertain cards may require user correction.
A detailed per-card confirmation table is not included in this iteration; warnings are shown and rows remain editable before search.
userVerificationStatement: A user can upload a NEURON/Master Duel-style deck image, receive recognized card candidates, and have those cards added to the purchase search rows in bulk before running search.
